title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 9
description: Ten questions on Exodus 9: the pestilence on the livestock, the boils and the very grievous hail.

questions.text: How many of the livestock of the children of Israel died in the pestilence?
questions.explanation: All the livestock of Egypt died, but of the livestock of the children of Israel, not one died.

questions.text: What did Moses sprinkle toward the sky in the sight of Pharaoh?
questions.explanation: Moses and Aaron took ashes of the furnace, and Moses sprinkled it toward the sky.

questions.text: What did the ashes become on man and animal?
questions.explanation: The ashes became boils and blisters breaking out on man and on animal throughout Egypt.

questions.text: Why couldn't the magicians stand before Moses?
questions.explanation: The magicians couldn't stand before Moses because of the boils, for the boils were on them and on all the Egyptians.

answers.text: Because they were afraid of the hail

questions.text: Why did Yahweh say he had made Pharaoh stand?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "For this cause I have made you stand: to show you my power, and that my name may be declared throughout all the earth."

answers.text: To show his power and make his name known
To give Egypt time to gather the harvest
To let Pharaoh build more cities
To test the faith of Moses

questions.text: What did the servants of Pharaoh who feared Yahweh's word do before the hail?
questions.explanation: Those who feared Yahweh's word made their servants and their livestock flee into the houses.

answers.text: Left their servants and livestock in the field
Fled with their families to Goshen
Begged Pharaoh to let Israel go
Brought their servants and livestock inside

questions.text: What came down together with the hail?
questions.explanation: Yahweh sent thunder and hail, and lightning flashed down to the earth, mixed with the hail.
Only in the land of Goshen, where the children of Israel were, there was no hail.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh confess to Moses and Aaron during the hail?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "I have sinned this time. Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked."

answers.text: "My magicians are greater than your God"
"Yahweh is righteous, and I and my people are wicked"

questions.text: Which crops were struck by the hail?
questions.explanation: The flax and the barley were struck, but the wheat and the spelt were not, for they had not grown up.
